---
title: "Session 4 · Bias & effect: can we trust it, how big is it?"
subtitle: "Weekend 2 · Sunday · 3 hours (15-minute break)"
---

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 3 (10 min)
- 4.1  Bias, confounding and causation (40 min)
- 4.2  Measuring disease and association + live 2x2 demo (30 min)
- Break (15 min) - then two 2x2 calculations (20 min)
- 4.3  Beyond single studies: tests, meta-analysis, appraisal (30 min)
- Proposal builder 4: exposure, outcomes, biases (30 min) - wrap-up

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 40 | **4.1 Bias, confounding and causation:** random error vs bias, selection, information, confounding (by indication), interaction, validity, Bradford Hill, reverse causation, how designs fight bias; spot-the-bias quiz |
| 0:50 | 08:50 | 30 | **4.2 Measuring disease and association:** prevalence vs incidence, risk, 2×2, RR / OR / RD / NNT, OR vs RR; **live 2×2 calculator demo** |
| 1:20 | 09:20 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:35 | 09:35 | 20 | Exercise: two 2×2 calculations |
| 1:55 | 09:55 | 30 | **4.3 Beyond single studies:** diagnostic accuracy (sens/spec, PPV & prevalence, ROC), systematic reviews & forest plots, heterogeneity, risk-of-bias tools, "are the conclusions supported?" (pair task) |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 4:** exposure & comparator, outcomes, main biases & mitigation |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).
